snippet.title: MER Climbing
snippet.description:
MER Climbing was developed by Parsec Software in 1995 for the company Falcon Breweries, promoting their non-carbonated lemonade MER. 

The game (at that time probably the worlds only existing mountain-climbing game) was delivered on one 3,5" floppy and integrated in a nation-wide advertising campaign.

System recommendations:
386 or better processor
1 Mb RAM
DOS 5.0 or later.
600 K disk space
Play from DOS.

Download size: 705 K

The source of this text and a download-link to the game can be found at http://www.digitalink.se/parsec/mer.html.

You can install & run it using DOSbox. I did it using 5000 cycles but 6000 would probably have been a bit smoother. Remember to edit the install.bat and change the A:\ into C:\ or the game will not be able to install.
